acquisition method: using “top 10” data dependent acquisition with a 60 millisecond fill time
alkylation reagent: treated with 50 mM chloroacetamide in UA buffer for 20 minutes in the dark
alkylation concentration: treated with 50 mM chloroacetamide in UA buffer
cleavage agent: subsequently digested with Lys-C, or Lys-C and Glu-C to truncate long substrate peptides
enrichment method: Proteins conjugated to 6His-SUMO2T90K were isolated by nickel affinity chromatography and subsequently digested with Lys-C, or Lys-C and Glu-C to truncate long substrate peptides. Peptides containing diGly-Lys were enriched with anti-K GG
instrument: analysed by liquid chromatography tandem MS on a Q Exactive mass spectrometer
ionization type: coupled to an EASY-nLC 1000 liquid chromatography system (Thermo Scientific) via an EASY-Spray ion source
labeling: no labeling strategy mentioned for sample-linked proteomics runs
reduction reagent: lysed in cell lysis buffer (6 M guanidinium-HCl, 100 mM sodium phosphate buffer pH 8.0, 10 mM Tris-HCl, 20 mM imidazole, 5 mM $ eta$-mercaptoethanol)
